derivation: Expected cost of preparing is C; not preparing is p*M. This analytic baseline is not an experiment result.
test_boundary_cases: Prepare at 15:40 finishes at 16:00; accepted by the declared action-completion rule.
Prepare after 15:40 cannot receive on-time credit.
A forecast submitted at outcome_time is not a legal future forecast, even though a previously started preparation may finish exactly then.
joint_negative_control: Two fixed marginals at 0.5 and a static additive loss: altering dependence alone must not alter expected loss for fixed actions.
joint_nonlinear_control: With capacity=1 and loss=max(Y_A+Y_B-1,0), simultaneous Bernoulli events have expected loss 0.5; mutually exclusive events have expected loss 0.
